scan_linter_check.description:
Flags execute() and executeAsync() on a RESTMessageV2 or SOAPMessageV2 (sn_ws. or unqualified) held in a local variable when both are true: - the call is not inside a try block, and - the response is ignored, or is used without calling getStatusCode(), haveError(), getErrorCode() or getErrorMessage() on it in the same function.
This is a potential problem: calls whose response is passed to another function, returned or stored are not reported, because the check cannot see handling done elsewhere; message objects not created in the same function are not checked. Server-side scripts only.
scan_linter_check.name: SN-INT-001: Outbound call without error handling
scan_linter_check.resolution_details: Check the outcome of every call: test response.haveError() and response.getStatusCode() and handle failures (log with context, retry where safe, surface the error). Wrap execute() in try/catch so exceptions do not abort the transaction silently.
scan_linter_check.short_description: REST/SOAP call outside try/catch whose response status is never checked.
scan_linter_check.sys_name: SN-INT-001: Outbound call without error handling
